headline: How to budget as a couple without fighting
lede: Short check-ins on the same shared numbers, every week or two.

pin.title: How to Budget as a Couple Without Fighting
pin.description: Most money fights come from different information, not bad habits. Ten or fifteen minutes every week or two, looking at the same numbers, covers what is coming in, what is committed, what is left, and anything irregular ahead, like holiday gifts or a trip.
